A '''skirmish''' took place in a [[Hospital (Bandomeer)|hospital]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] in [[987 BBY]]. After a failed kidnapping attempt on an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Muun official|official]], the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[Salto Zendar]] was seriously injured. He received treatment in the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] on Bandomeer, but the Banking Clan put a large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on him, and several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] tracked him to the hospital.

The bounty hunter [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]] was the first to find Zendar, but a [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]], [[Serra]], blocked her path. A [[Unidentified Twi'lek bounty hunter|Twi'lek bounty hunter]] suddenly arrived and shot Lucia, knocked Serra aside, and dragged Zendar away. Lucia attempted to follow but soon blacked out, and Serra quickly performed life-saving surgery on her. By the time the ensuing skirmish was over, Zendar was [[Death/Legends|dead]], along with four bounty hunters, two patients, and four members of the hospital staff. Afterward, Lucia vowed to [[Bodyguard/Legends|protect]] Serra for saving her life.

==Prelude==
Around [[987 BBY]], thirteen years after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|conclusion]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[Salto Zendar]] and his three brothers attempted to kidnap a high-ranking [[Muun official]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] in order to hold him for ransom. They failed in their task, however&mdash;two of Zendar's brothers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and one was captured during the venture, while Zendar himself was seriously wounded and forced to flee.<ref name="doe" />

Zendar was taken in at a [[Hospital (Bandomeer)|hospital]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]<ref name="doe" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> where he began to receive treatment for his injuries, although he remained in critical condition. Meanwhile, the InterGalactic Banking Clan put an exceptionally large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Zendar's head and numerous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] decided to hunt him down.<ref name="doe" />

==The skirmish==
Several bounty hunters tracked Zendar to the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]], where the Meerian was still recovering. [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], a bounty hunter who had fought for the [[Gloom Walkers]] unit of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the New [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Wars, was the first to find him. However, her path to the fugitive was blocked by [[Serra]], a [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] who worked at the hospital. Serra refused to allow the Meerian to be moved while he remained in his critical condition, even when Lucia held her at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]].<ref name="doe" />

Lucia hesitated at the prospect of shooting an innocent nurse just to collect the bounty on Zendar, but a [[Unidentified Twi'lek bounty hunter|Twi'lek bounty hunter]] suddenly arrived and shot Lucia in the [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] from point-blank range. Serra attempted to block the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek's]] path, but he [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]]-whipped her and then grabbed Zendar and dragged him out of the room into the hall. Lucia attempted to crawl after them, but another bounty hunter appeared, shooting the Twi'lek in the back and taking Zendar; Lucia then fell unconscious as the battle for Zendar continued.<ref name="doe" />

Serra quickly moved Lucia back into the room and performed life-saving surgery on her while the [[Lightfight|firefight]] continued outside. Despite the fact that Lucia had held her at blasterpoint and that she had just been pistol-whipped, Serra successfully completed the surgery, saving Lucia's life. As the skirmish came to an end, four bounty hunters were counted among the dead, along with three of the hospital's security guards, one member of the hospital nursing staff, two patients, and Zendar himself.<ref name="doe" />

==Aftermath==
From her blaster wound and subsequent surgery, Lucia obtained a scar running from her navel to her rib cage that she bore for the rest of her life. Lucia knew that she owed her life to Serra, so she vowed to watch over the young [[Gender/Legends|woman]] from that day on. At first, Serra was reluctant to have Lucia constantly protecting her, but eventually she came to appreciate having a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], and the two became close friends. When Serra [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]] of [[Doan]], Lucia joined the [[Doan Royal Guard]] so that she could continue her duties as Serra's bodyguard.<ref name="doe" />

==Behind the scenes==
This skirmish was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''. Because the prose that describes the skirmish in the novel is from Lucia's point of view, the exact events of the skirmish after she fell unconscious are not specified.<ref name="doe" />
